name: fjellrute
//: This is the workspace root. It owns three things and no application code: the Cloudflare Worker (worker/, deployed from wrangler.jsonc at this level), the verification harness (scripts/), and the toolchain that has to see the whole tree at once — eslint, tsc -b, wrangler. The browser app's own dependencies live in apps/web/package.json. The script NAMES below are load-bearing: .githooks/pre-push runs `pnpm build` and `pnpm lint` from here, so they must keep working from the root however the tree is arranged underneath.

scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'pre-push build gate active'
scripts.dev: concurrently -n vite,worker -c cyan,yellow "pnpm -C apps/web dev" "wrangler dev"
scripts.test:gdpr: pnpm test:deletion && pnpm test:privacy && pnpm test:policies
scripts.test: pnpm test:gdpr && pnpm test:landing && pnpm test:appbase && pnpm test:notfound && pnpm test:ratelimit && pnpm test:password && pnpm test:briefing && pnpm test:viewswitch && pnpm test:parking
